name: Celery-Apple Quinoa Salad with Peanuts, Dates, Parmesan & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 sticks celery
6 Granny Smith apples
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and slice shallots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and dates. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted
¾ cup medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl, along with the cooled quinoa, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
